title: Kishen Kanhaiya
desc: Twin brothers Kishen and Kanhaiya, separated at birth - one rich, and one poor - reunite years later to join forces and battle evil, proving blood ties conquer all odds.

title: Akele Hum Akele Tum
desc: Rohit and Kiran, aspiring singers, fall in love and marry. But responsibilities weigh heavily, straining their bond until Kiran decides to leave, breaking Rohit's heart and dreams.

title: Don - The Chase Begins Again
desc: Vijay, a lookalike of crime lord Don, is recruited to uncover his secrets. When the officer guiding him dies, Vijay is trapped in a deadly maze, struggling to prove his true identity.

title: De De Pyaar De 2
desc: Ashish Mehra, a London-based NRI investor, visits his girlfriend's family, but tensions escalate when her father discovers the truth about Ashish's real age.

title: Madgaon Express
desc: Childhood friends Dodo, Ayush, and Pinku head to Goa for fun, but a chain of impulsive choices, wild detours, and hilariously bad decisions turns their dream trip into total chaos.

title: Murder 2
desc: Arjun, a former cop, takes on the case of missing sex workers. To catch the culprit, young Reshma bravely steps in as bait-risking everything to expose the truth.

title: Judaai
desc: Driven by greed, Kajal urges her honest husband Raj to marry his boss's wealthy daughter Janhvi, but her plan triggers unforeseen consequences that threaten their lives.

title: Kya Kool Hain Hum 3
desc: Kanhaiya, an adult film actor in Thailand, falls for Shalu. To win over her traditional father, he fakes a respectable family with help from his quirky co-stars.

title: Run
desc: Jhanvi and Siddharth are deeply in love, but her brother Ganpat, a gangster, disapproves of their relationship and plots to kill Siddharth.

title: Krrish
desc: Krrish, gifted with superhuman powers, falls for Priya and travels to Singapore, where shocking truths about his father push him to embrace destiny and fight.

title: Satyam Shivam Sundaram
desc: Rajeev marries Roopa, a beautiful singer, but he struggles to accept her when he discovers her disfigured face, causing emotional pain and conflict in their relationship.

title: Dhamaal
desc: Roy, Manav, Aditya and Boman chase a hidden treasure in Goa, but as Inspector Kabir gets on their trail, their fun-filled adventure turns into a chaotic race against time.

title: Phool Aur Kante
desc: Ajay, the son of a crime boss, lives peacefully until rivals kidnap his father. Forced into the underworld, he must confront danger and fight to save his family.

title: Company
desc: Chandu and Mallik form a gang and gain notoriety. But ego and tension tear them apart, leading to betrayal and the collapse of their criminal empire.

title: Anjaan Raahen
desc: In this gripping tale, Anand, a teacher in India, tackles sex education in a conservative school. Amidst personal struggles and accusations, he navigates complex relationships with students and colleagues.
